title: Advanced World War: Sennen Teikoku no Koubou: Last of the Millennium
native_title: アドバンスド・ワールド・ウォー ～千年帝国の興亡～
overview:
The latest in the World Advanced series!

Command the German forces in a turn-based war simulation set on the European front of World War II. Your career begins at the military academy, where lectures teach the controls and a graduation exam awaits, and where you meet the air force general who becomes your partner.

The campaign opens with the invasion of Poland and branches according to your results and choices. Land and sea units fight on the ground map while aircraft fly on a separate air map. Generals lead up to nine units each, gain experience and earn decorations, and between operations you spend points to develop, build and upgrade weapons. Day and night turns and changing weather affect every move, and battles play out in 3D combat scenes.

- Air and land dual map system
- Military Academy tutorial mode
- General system that writes you into history
- Campaign with multiple endings, plus a mode for up to 4 players
- Memory backup

ワールドアドバンスドシリーズ最新作！
